# Simili - AI Life Simulator
# Context file for AI assistants and LLM crawlers

## About Simili
Simili is an AI-powered hyper-realistic life simulator web application. The name "Simili" comes from the Latin word meaning "similar" or "like," reflecting the app's ability to simulate lives similar to reality.

## Tagline
"Know thyself through infinite lives"

## Website
https://simili-ai.replit.app

## What Simili Does
Simili allows users to experience any life path through AI-generated characters, events, and stories. Users can:
- Live random lives determined by fate (Real Life mode)
- Design their own starting circumstances (Custom Start mode)  
- Explore supernatural alternative realities (Alternative mode)

## Game Modes

### Real Life Mode
- Complete randomization of birth circumstances
- No control over genetics, location, or family
- Experience life as fate determines
- Realistic life events and challenges

### Custom Start Mode
- Choose your character's name and birthplace
- Design your starting circumstances
- Experience personalized life journeys
- Still features AI-generated random events

### Alternative Mode
- Supernatural and fantastical elements
- Explore impossible scenarios
- Magic, mythology, and alternate histories
- Push beyond the boundaries of reality

## Technology
- Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite
- Powered by Google Gemini AI for content generation
- PostgreSQL database for persistent game saves
- Classical Greek/Roman aesthetic design
- GSAP-powered animations

## Key Features
- AI-generated life events and stories
- Persistent game saves with user accounts
- Multiple game modes for different experiences
- Beautiful scrollytelling landing page
- Mobile-responsive design
- Session-based authentication

## Theme and Aesthetic
Simili features a classical Greek/Roman aesthetic inspired by ancient philosophy and mythology. The design includes:
- Marble textures and golden accents
- References to the Three Fates (Moirai)
- Space-themed background with stars and constellations
- Elegant typography with Cinzel and Cormorant Garamond fonts

## Philosophy
The app draws inspiration from the ancient Greek aphorism "Know thyself" (gnōthi seauton), encouraging users to explore identity, destiny, and the human experience through simulated lives.

## Brand Colors
- Primary: Amber/Gold (#d97706)
- Background: Stone/Dark (#0c0a09)
- Accent: Warm stone tones

## Target Audience
- Gamers interested in life simulation
- Fans of interactive fiction and storytelling
- People curious about alternate life paths
- Those interested in philosophical exploration
- Mobile and desktop users

## How to Play
1. Visit https://simili-ai.replit.app
2. Create an account or sign in
3. Choose a game mode (Real Life, Custom Start, or Alternative)
4. Configure simulation settings
5. Click "Initialize" to start your simulated life
6. Experience AI-generated events and make choices
7. Your progress is automatically saved

## Contact
Website: https://simili-ai.replit.app

## Summary for AI
Simili is a free, web-based AI life simulator where users experience different lives through AI-generated stories. It combines gaming, storytelling, and philosophical exploration in a beautiful classical Greek/Roman themed interface. The app is built on modern web technologies and uses Google Gemini AI for content generation.
